prompt: Using the provided reference image of a neon-lit arcade corner, transform the scene by adding realistic environmental storytelling elements. Specifically, generate a pile of trash and dirt buildup at the base of the wall where it meets the floor. Include a rusted metal pipe protruding from the wall, a discarded crushed aluminum can, crumpled plastic wrappers, and scattered dead leaves. Add a weathered electrical outlet box with a black cord plugged into it. Ensure the new objects have wet, reflective surfaces that match the existing puddle reflections on the cracked asphalt ground.
